description: Golden cases for the read-only lib/git queries (#252), checked by test/oneshot-git-parity.bats (the shell) and Credfeto.Orchestrator.Git.Tests (the tool). Each scenario's setup runs in an empty directory of the scenario's name, after the prelude, in the environment below with the variables under unset removed; the prelude pins the identity and dates, so the commit ids are the same on every machine. Each case runs its function from that directory, in the same environment, with REPO_WORK_DIR set to <directory>/<repo> (empty when repo is empty) and @ROOT@ in an argument replaced by the directory, and records what the function prints (stdout) and returns (status). tool: answers (the tool must print and return the same), refuses (the tool must exit 3, so bash answers) or not-called (bash returns before it asks the tool). test/oneshot-git-parity.bats regenerates stdout and status when GIT_PARITY_REGENERATE is set

scenarios.name: checkouts
scenarios.setup:
git init -q --bare -b main origin.git
git clone -q origin.git seed 2> /dev/null
printf 'one\n' > seed/file.txt
git -C seed add file.txt
commit seed initial
git -C seed push -q origin main
for spec in feat/12-thing:2 chore/12:0 fix/120-other:1 bug/1120-x:1 Feat/34_x:1 34-plain:1 feat2/56-x:1 \
    a/b/56-y:1 feat/78:1 feat/78-later:1 dependabot/nuget/90-x:1 docs/readme:1 feat/77-café:1 feat/91-behind:0; do
    branch_on seed origin "${spec%:*}" "${spec##*:}"
done
commit seed "main moves on"
git -C seed push -q origin main
git init -q --bare -b main upstream.git
branch_on seed "${PWD}/upstream.git" 66-z 1
branch_on seed "${PWD}/upstream.git" feat/55-up 1
git init -q --bare -b main accents.git
git -C seed push -q "${PWD}/accents.git" main
branch_on seed "${PWD}/accents.git" fé/88-x 1
branch_on seed "${PWD}/accents.git" feat/89é 1
branch_on seed "${PWD}/accents.git" feat/12-also 1
git init -q --bare -b main empty.git
for name in clean behind unstaged staged untracked deleted detached feature accented conflicted remotes; do
    git clone -q origin.git "${name}"
done
git clone -q accents.git accents
git clone -q empty.git emptyclone 2> /dev/null
git -C behind reset -q --hard HEAD~1
printf 'two\n' > unstaged/file.txt
printf 'two\n' > staged/file.txt
git -C staged add file.txt
printf 'new\n' > untracked/new.txt
rm deleted/file.txt
git -C detached checkout -q --detach HEAD~1
git -C feature checkout -q -b feat/12-thing --track origin/feat/12-thing
git -C accented checkout -q -b feat/77-café --track origin/feat/77-café
git -C conflicted checkout -q -b side
printf 'side\n' > conflicted/file.txt
commit_all conflicted side
git -C conflicted checkout -q main
printf 'main\n' > conflicted/file.txt
commit_all conflicted "main side"
git -C conflicted merge -q side > /dev/null 2>&1 || true
git -C remotes remote add upstream ../upstream.git
git -C remotes fetch -q upstream
git init -q -b main unborn
git init -q -b main unbornstaged
printf 'one\n' > unbornstaged/file.txt
git -C unbornstaged add file.txt
mkdir plain

scenarios.name: worktrees
scenarios.setup:
git init -q --bare -b main origin.git
git clone -q origin.git seed 2> /dev/null
printf 'one\n' > seed/file.txt
printf 'two\n' > seed/other.txt
printf '*.log\n' > seed/.gitignore
git -C seed add file.txt other.txt .gitignore
commit seed initial
git -C seed push -q origin main
git -C seed push -q origin main:feat/1-x
for name in clean modified staged both untracked newdir deleted renamed spaced accented ignored conflicted detached \
    stashes badstash; do
    git clone -q origin.git "${name}"
done
git init -q -b main unborn
git init -q -b main unbornstaged
printf 'one\n' > unbornstaged/file.txt
git -C unbornstaged add file.txt
mkdir plain
printf 'changed\n' > modified/file.txt
printf 'changed\n' > staged/file.txt
git -C staged add file.txt
printf 'changed\n' > both/file.txt
git -C both add file.txt
printf 'again\n' > both/file.txt
printf 'new\n' > untracked/new.txt
mkdir -p newdir/dir/sub
printf 'a\n' > newdir/dir/a.txt
printf 'b\n' > newdir/dir/b.txt
printf 'c\n' > newdir/dir/sub/c.txt
printf 'd\n' > newdir/top.txt
rm deleted/file.txt
git -C deleted rm -q other.txt
git -C renamed mv file.txt moved.txt
printf 'changed\n' > renamed/other.txt
printf 's\n' > 'spaced/a b.txt'
printf 't\n' > "spaced/tab$(printf '\t')here.txt"
printf 'q\n' > 'spaced/quote"d.txt'
printf 'n\n' > spaced/new
printf 'x\n' > accented/café.txt
printf 'changed\n' > accented/other.txt
printf 'x\n' > ignored/build.log
git -C conflicted checkout -q -b side
printf 'side\n' > conflicted/file.txt
commit_all conflicted side
git -C conflicted checkout -q main
printf 'main\n' > conflicted/file.txt
commit_all conflicted "main side"
git -C conflicted merge -q side > /dev/null 2>&1 || true
printf 'new\n' > conflicted/extra.txt
git -C detached checkout -q --detach HEAD
printf 'changed\n' > detached/file.txt
stash_with() {
    local repo="$1" message="$2"
    printf '%s\n' "${message}" >> "${repo}/file.txt"
    if [ -n "${message}" ]; then
        git -C "${repo}" stash push -q -m "${message}"
    else
        git -C "${repo}" stash push -q
    fi
}
auto="orchestrator-autostash"
stash_with stashes "${auto} main 2026-01-01T00:00:01Z: dirty tree on unowned branch"
stash_with stashes ""
stash_with stashes "keep me"
git -C stashes checkout -q -b feat/1-x --track origin/feat/1-x
stash_with stashes "${auto} feat/1-x 2026-01-01T00:00:02Z: dirty tree on unowned branch"
git -C stashes checkout -q --detach
stash_with stashes "${auto} detached 2026-01-01T00:00:03Z: dirty tree on unowned branch"
git -C stashes checkout -q main
stash_with stashes "${auto}x not one"
stash_with stashes "${auto}"
stash_with stashes "note: ${auto} not one either"
stash_with stashes "${AUTO_UPPER:-ORCHESTRATOR-AUTOSTASH} other case"
git -C stashes checkout -q -b feat/77-café
stash_with stashes "${auto} feat/77-café 2026-01-01T00:00:04Z: dirty tree on unowned branch"
git -C stashes checkout -q main
stash_with stashes "${auto} main 2026-01-01T00:00:05Z: dirty tree on unowned branch"
stash_with badstash "${auto} main 2026-01-01T00:00:06Z: dirty tree on unowned branch"
git -C badstash checkout -q -b "bad$(printf '\377')name"
stash_with badstash "${auto} bad 2026-01-01T00:00:07Z: dirty tree on unowned branch"
git -C badstash checkout -q main
# The branch is deleted again (its stash keeps the name): .NET cannot delete a file whose name is not UTF-8
git -C badstash branch -q -D "bad$(printf '\377')name"
stash_with badstash "${auto} main 2026-01-01T00:00:08Z: dirty tree on unowned branch"
git -C badstash stash list > /dev/null
